rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, ALSO KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, SECTION 73 ON THE PROHIBITION AGAINST RESIGNATION OF OFFICIALS BEING RECALLED
rows.abstract: Seeks to allow an official who is the subject of a recall process to voluntarily resign.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO DEVELOP AN EDUCATIONAL STRATEGY THAT ADDRESSES THE EDUCATIONAL NEEDS OF ALL MEMBERS OF LOCAL COMMUNITIES
rows.title_short: \"21st Century Community Learning Center's Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Extends grants to schools that allow the use of the school facilities, equipment and resources for senior citizens programs and services for persons with disabilities; children's day care activities; services for out-of-school youth; and employment counseling, training and placement; among others.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO MAKE A SEPARATE COURSE ON ETHICS COMPULSORY AT ALL LEVELS OF GRADE SCHOOL, HIGH SCHOOL, AND EVERY DEGREE COURSE IN ANY COLLEGE OR UNIVERSITY
rows.title_short: \"Compulsory Teaching of Ethics Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Mandates the inclusion of Ethics in the curriculum of all schools.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING AS A CRIME THE ACT OF DRIVING A MOTOR VEHICLE WHILE UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF LIQUOR AND/OR PROHIBITED DRUGS AND PROVIDING GRADUATED PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.title_short: \"Anti-Drunk Driving Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Proposes the following penalties for driving while under the influence of liquor or prohibited drugs:  a) 1st offense - fine of P1,000 and suspension of driver's license for one (1) year; b) 2nd offense and subsequent offenses - fine of P5,000 and suspension of driver's license for five (5) years.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2009-09-23

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ENSURE PREGNANT WOMAN'S ACCESS TO A SKILLED BIRTH ATTENDANT AT THE TIME OF CHILDBIRTH AND IMMEDIATELY THEREAFTER
rows.title_short: \"Bantay Buntis Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Aims to ensure that all pregnant women are cared for by professional health workers during and immediately after childbirth.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN PRACTICES INVOLVING COMMERCIAL USES OF TELEPHONE FACSIMILE MACHINES
rows.title_short: \"Facsimile Advertising Regulations Act\"
rows.abstract: Prohibits the use of a telephone facsimile machine to send an unsolicited advertisement.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NO. 3815, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PENAL CODE, SECTION 248, TO DEFINE AND PENALIZE THE CRIME OF MURDER COMMITTED UNDER EXTRAORDINARY CIRCUMSTANCES
rows.abstract: Seeks to penalize any person who, while operating a motor vehicle, runs over a pedestrian and deliberately causes the death of said pedestrian.  Also proposes to include said crime of murder committed under extraordinary circumstances in the definition of the crime of murder.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT 386, ALSO KNOWN AS THE CIVIL CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, ARTICLE 1032, ON UNWORTHINESS TO SUCCEED
rows.abstract: Seeks to include in the list of persons disqualified to succeed by reason of unworthiness parents who induce their sons to lead corrupt or immoral lives.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 245 OF THE PENAL CODE, ENTITLED \"ABUSE AGAINST CHASTITY\", BY RENAMING THE FELONY TO \"SEXUAL HARASSMENT BY PUBLIC OFFICERS\" AND ADDING ANOTHER PARAGRAPH TO BE CITED AS PARAGRAPH THREE (3) DEALING WITH CASES NOT FALLING WITHIN THE COVERAGE OF PARAGRAPHS ONE (1) AND TWO (2) OF THE SAME ARTICLE
rows.abstract: Seeks to expand the coverage of Article 245 of the Penal Code to include acts constituting sexual harassment committed by public officials.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F039
rows.title_full: ISANG BATAS NA NAGTATATAG NG TANGGAPAN O BUREAU NG MGA NAWAWALANG TAO, PAGLALAAN NG PONDO PARA DITO AT PARA SA IBA PANG LAYUNIN (AN ACT CREATING A MISSING PERSON'S BUREAU, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES)
rows.abstract: Bumubuo ng Tanggapan ng mga Nawawalang Tao sa Philippine National Police na maglilingkod bilang pambansang rehistro para sa pag-uulat at pagtatala ng lahat ng nawawalang tao. (Establishes the Missing Persons Bureau within the Philippine National Police that will serve as the national register for the reporting and recording of all missing persons.)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F039
rows.title_full: ISANG BATAS NA NAGTATATAG NG ISANG AKADEMYA SA ISPORTS AT KULTURA SA MUNISIPALIDAD NG GUIMBA, PROBINSYA NG NUEVA ECIJA, PAGLALAAN NG PONDO PARA DITO AT SA IBA PANG LAYUNIN (AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SPORTS AND CULTURAL ACADEMY IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF GUIMBA, PROVINCE OF NUEVA ECIJA, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F039
rows.title_full: ISANG BATAS SA REGULASYON AT PAGPAPAUNLAD NG INDUSTRIYANG MOTORSIKLO AT TRAYSIKEL, PAGLALAAN NG PONDO PARA DITO AT IBA PANG LAYUNIN (AN ACT FOR THE REGULATION AND DEVELOPMENT OF THE MOTORCYCLE AND TRICYCLE INDUSTRY, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES)
rows.title_short: \"Batas sa Pagpapaunlad ng Industriyang Motorsiklo at Traysikel\" (\"Motorcycle and Tricycle Industry Development Act\")
rows.abstract: Nagsusulong ng mga hakbang para mapangasiwaan ang mga kaugalian o practices sa nasabing industriya at magbigay ng mga benepisyo sa sektor na ito.  (Seeks to regulate practices in the industry and extend benefits to this sector.)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2008-08-04

rows.author: D078
rows.title_full: AN ACT RESETTING THE DATE FOR REGULAR ELECTIONS FOR ELECTIVE OFFICIALS OF THE AUTONOMOUS REGION IN MUSLIM MINDANAO (ARMM), SYNCHRONIZING ARMM ELECTIONS WITH THE SYNCHRONIZED NATIONAL AND LOCAL ELECTIONS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9333, ENTITLED \"AN ACT FIXING THE DATE FOR REGULAR ELECTIONS FOR ELECTIVE OFFICIALS OF THE AUTONOMOUS REGION IN MUSLIM MINDANAO\", AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Substituted by HB04885
rows.remarks: Certified as Urgent together with HB04835 on July 29, 2008.

rows.author: F093
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE OVERSEAS WORKERS' WELFARE ADMINISTRATION FUND (OWWA FUND) AS DIRECT SERVICES FOR OFWS FUND
rows.title_short: \"Direct Services for OFWs Fund Act\"
rows.abstract: Provides for 80% of the OWWA Fund to be used strictly for the provision of direct services to overseas Filipino workers while 20% shall be used to augment the government-allocated budget for the operations, personnel and administration of the Overseas Workers' Welfare Administration.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on OVERSEAS WORKERS AFFAIRS since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE PHILIPPINE TERRITORY AS DETERMINED BY THE ARCHIPELAGIC BASELINES HEREIN PROVIDED AND TO INCLUDE OTHER TERRITORIES BY WHICH THE PHILIPPINES HAS HISTORIC AND LEGAL TITLE
rows.title_short: \"Philippine Territory Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Seeks to define the Philippine territory in accordance with international laws and to include the Kalayaan Island Group and Sabah.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on FOREIGN AFFAIRS since 2008-08-04

rows.author: F045
rows.title_full: AN ACT RESETTING THE REGULAR ELECTIONS FOR ELECTIVE OFFICIALS OF THE AUTONOMOUS REGION IN MUSLIM MINDANAO, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9333 AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Substituted by HB04885
rows.remarks: Certified as Urgent together with HB04832 on July 29, 2008.

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING RETIREMENT BENEFITS TO COURT OFFICIALS IN THE JUDICIARY WITH THE EQUIVALENT RANK OF JUSTICES OF THE COURT OF APPEALS AND JUDGES OF THE REGIONAL TRIAL COURT, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 910, AS AMENDED, ENTITLED \"AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE RETIREMENT OF JUSTICES OF THE SUPREME COURT AND THE COURT OF APPEALS, FOR THE ENFORCEMENT OF THE PROVISIONS HEREOF BY THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM, AND TO REPEAL COMMONWEALTH ACT NUMBERED FIVE HUNDRED AND THIRTY SIX\"
rows.abstract: Seeks to grant retirement beneftis to the Court Admninistrator and Deputy Court Administrator of the Supreme Court, the Clerk of Court and Deputy Clerk of Court of the Court of Appeals, the Chancellor and Vice-chancellor of the Philippine Judicial Academy and the Clerk of Court and Deputy Clerk of Court of the Sandiganbayan and the Court of Tax Appeals who have been granted the equivalent rank of justices of the Court of Appeals and judges of the Regional Trial Court.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING ALL SUBDIVISION OWNERS OR DEVELOPERS TO DESIGNATE ROADS FOR PUBLIC USE WITHIN THE SUBDIVISION TO ACCESS ADJACENT SUBDIVISIONS OR ANY GOVERNMENT OFFICES OR PUBLIC ESTABLISHMENTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 957, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE SUBDIVISION AND CONDOMINIUM BUYERS' PROTECTIVE DECREE\"
rows.abstract: Directs subdivision owners and developers to allow the public free access to adjacent subdivisions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on METRO MANILA DEVELOPMENT since 2008-08-05

rows.author: A014
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 43 OF R.A. 9136, ALSO KNOWN AS \"ELECTRIC POWER INDUSTRY REFORM ACT OF 2001\", BY REGULATING THE POWER OF THE ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION IN FIXING THE CAP OF RECOVERABLE SYSTEM LOSSES OF DISTRIBUTION UTILITIES, REMOVING ADMINISTRATIVE LOSSES FROM THE DEFINITION OF SYSTEM LOSSES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to set a cap on system losses that the Energy Regulatory Commission may impose.  Also proposes to remove administrative losses, including \"own-use\" charges of power distributors, from the definition of system loss.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 2008-08-05

rows.author: A014
rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT RA10026 (Lapsed into law on 2010-03-11)
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 108 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED, BY EXCLUDING SYSTEM LOSSES OF DISTRIBUTION UTILITIES FROM THE TERM \"GROSS RECEIPTS\" AND EXEMPTING THE SAME FROM VALUE ADDED TAX, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to exclude charges for system loss from the ambit of the value-added tax.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05210

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NO. 3815, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PENAL CODE, ARTICLES 171 AND 172, IMPOSING STIFFER PENALTIES FOR THE FALSIFICATION OF TORRENS CERTIFICATES OF TITLE
rows.abstract: Seeks to curb  the practice of fabrication of Torrens title by imposing higher penalties on any person who falsifies such documents.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRARIAN REFORM AND THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE TO SUBMIT AN ANNUAL REPORT TO CONGRESS ON STATISTICS RELATING TO THE CONVERSION OF AGRICULTURAL LAND TO NON-AGRICULTURAL USES INCLUDING A REVIEW OF EXISTING POLICIES AND PROCEDURES
rows.title_short: \"Agricultural Land Protection Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Provides for the review of existing government policies and procedures covering agricultural land conversion.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NO. 3815, ALSO KNOWN AS THE PENAL CODE, ARTICLE 310 ON QUALIFIED THEFT
rows.abstract: Seeks to expand the definition of the crime of qualified theft to cover AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS taken from the premises WHERE IT IS CULTIVATED AND/OR STORED.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE USE OF ETHANOL AS ALTERNATIVE TRANSPORT FUEL, ESTABLISHING FOR THE PURPOSE THE NATIONAL FUEL ETHANOL PROGRAM, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: \"Fuel Ethanol Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Promotes the use of ethyl alcohol or ethanol as an alternative transport fuel through the fuel ethanol program.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH TO CARRY OUT PROGRAMS AND GRANTS REGARDING THE PREVENTION AND MANAGEMENT OF ASTHMA AND RELATED RESPIRATORY PROBLEMS FOR LOW-INCOME FAMILIES AND COMMUNITIES
rows.title_short: \"Asthma Awareness, Education and Treatment Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Extends grants to public and private entities that aid low-income families in the prevention, management and treatment of asthma and related respiratory problems.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WELFARE AND SOCIAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAM TO FAMILIES LEFT BEHIND BY OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS
rows.title_short: \"Left-Behind Households of OFWs Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Seeks the establishment of OFW family centers that shall provide welfare assistance and counseling services to the families left-behind by OFWs.  Also directs the OWWA to develop a program for the re-unification and reintegration of returning OFWs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on OVERSEAS WORKERS AFFAIRS since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING DISCRIMINATION IN THE PAYMENT OF WAGES ON ACCOUNT OF SEX
rows.title_short: \"Fair Pay Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Declares it unlawful to pay different wages/salary rates on account of sex.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 386, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CIVIL CODE, ARTICLE 1723, ON THE LIABILITY OF ENGINEERS, ARCHITECTS OR CONTRACTORS ARISING FROM NON-OBSERVANCE OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS OR THE USE OF MATERIALS OF INFERIOR QUALITY
rows.abstract: Aims to hold the contractor directly responsible for any structural defect arising from the consruction work undertaken by a subcontractor.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F094
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO IMPROVE THE SAFETY OF NON-MOTORIZED TRANSPORTATION, INCLUDING PEDESTRIAN AND BICYCLE SAFETY, IN THE VICINITY OF SCHOOLS
rows.title_short: \"Safe Routes to Schools Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Encourages students to walk or use non-motorized vehicles in going to school.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2008-08-05

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 1 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1602, ENTITLED \"PRESCRIBING STIFFER PENALTIES ON ILLEGAL GAMBLING\"
rows.abstract: Proposes to impose stiffer penalties on illegal gambling.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2008-08-05

rows.mother_status: Bill reported out 2010-02-02 (#02652);Submitted by SOCIAL SERVICES
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 22 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8552, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"DOMESTIC ADOPTION ACT OF 1998\"
rows.abstract: Seeks to extend the prescriptive period for availment of the amnesty from pecuniary and penal sanctions imposed against individuals who falsified the birth certificates of their child under their custody through the registration of a simulated birth certificate.  Proposes to extend the prescriptive period from five (5) years to another fifteen (15) years.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07186

rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING THE CRIME OF PREMATURE MARRIAGES IN ARTICLE 351 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: Seeks to repeal Article 351 of the Penal Code which prohibits widows from remarrying within 301 days after the death of the husband.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-08-05

rows.author: D083
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE MT. INAYAWAN RANGE, LOCATED IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF NUNUNGAN, PROVINCE OF LANAO DEL NORTE, AS A PROTECTED AREA, PROVIDING FOR ITS MANAGEMENT AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.status: Approved by the Committee on Appropriations on 2009-12-08

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on Appropriations on 2009-12-08

rows.author: F031
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE FRAMEWORK PROGRAM FOR CLIMATE CHANGE, CREATING THE CLIMATE CHANGE COMMISSION, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Philippine Climate Change Act of 2007\"
rows.abstract: Creates the National Framework Program on Climate Change Mitigation, Adaptation and Communication. Is also establishes mechanisms to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from the energy, power, transport and manufacturing sectors; and institutionalizes the country's commitments to international efforts to address the problem of climate change.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05982

committee_action.action: Approved by the Committee on Appropriations on 2008-12-03

principal_referral.committee: MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISE DEVELOPMENT

rows.author: F050
rows.title_full: AN ACT RECLASSIFYING A CERTAIN PORTION OF THE DEVELOPED TIMBERLAND IN BARANGAY PUYAT, MUNICIPALITY OF CARMEN, PROVINCE OF SURIGAO DEL SUR INTO ALIENABLE AND DISPOSABLE LAND
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F050
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING EVERY TWENTY-THIRD DAY OF JUNE OF EVERY YEAR AS A SPECIAL NON-WORKING HOLIDAY IN THE CITY OF TANDAG, SURIGAO DEL SUR, TO BE KNOWN AS THE \"CHARTER DAY OF TANDAG CITY\"
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-08-05

rows.author: D045
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING HOARDING, PRICE MANIPULATION AND PROFITEERING OF STAPLE FOOD ARTICLES AND COMMODITIES AS ECONOMIC SABOTAGE AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.title_short: \"Anti-Hoarding, Price Manipulation and Profiteering Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Imposes the penalty of reclusion mayor in its maximum term to reclusion temporal in its minimum term and a fine of not less than P500,000 but not more than P10 million on any person found to be engaged in hoarding, price manipulation and profiteering.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2008-08-05

rows.author: A014
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 7, AND 8 OF R.A. 8794, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS AN ACT IMPOSING A MOTOR VEHICLE'S USER'S CHARGE ON OWNERS OF ALL TYPES OF MOTOR VEHICLES, PROVIDING FOR THE AUTOMATIC ACCRUAL OF FUNDS COLLECTED TO THE NATIONAL TREASURY, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides for all monies collected under RA 8794 to automatically accrue to the National Treasury and to be made available for the general purposes of the government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2008-09-15

rows.author: A014
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING ALL COMMON CARRIERS WITH A CAPACITY OF AT LEAST FIFTY (50) PASSENGERS TO ESTABLISH A CRISIS MANAGEMENT TEAM, DEFINING ITS FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Mandates the establishment of crisis managgement teams in common carriers with a carrying capacity of at least fifty (50) passengers to ensure their readiness in case of an accident or disaster.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F057
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ESTABLISH HOUSING LOAN REPAYMENT PROGRAM, PROVIDING THE MECHANISMS THEREFORE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Housing Loan Repayment Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Grants beneficiaries of low-cost  and socialized housing loans with at least six (6) months of unpaid monthly amortizattions the option to restructure their loans.
rows.status: Tabled by the Committee on 2009-03-04

committee_action.action: Under deliberation by the Mother Committee on 2009-03-04

rows.author: F082
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING SPECIAL PRIVILEGES AND INCENTIVES FOR TEACHERS IN PRIVATE AND PUBLIC SCHOOLS, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Special Privileges and Incentives Act for Teachers\"
rows.abstract: Seeks to grant elementary and high school teachers the following incentives, among others:  a) 20% discount from service establishments and in the purchase of medicines; b) 20% discount on admission fees charged by theaters, cinemas, etc.; c) exemption from the payment of individual income tax; d) exemption from training fees; e) free medical and dental service in government medical facilities; and f) 20% discount on medical and dental services in private hospitals.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F082
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE PHILIPPINE RICE REGULATORY ADMINISTRATION (PHILRRA), PROVIDING FUNDS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Philippine Rice Regulatory Administration (PHILRRA) Act of 2007\"
rows.abstract: Establishes the Philippine Rice Regulatory Administration that shall promote the interest of the rice industry, direct and determine policy direction, address future rice crises, and address food security issues, among others.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2008-08-05

rows.author: D083
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A NATIONAL RAILWAY SYSTEM IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Philippine National Railway Act of 2008\"
rows.abstract: Establishes the Authority that shall regulate the planning, construction, management, safety and security of the railways.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2008-08-05

rows.author: F039
rows.title_full: ISANG BATAS NA NAG-AAMYENDA SA ARTIKULO 11 NG KAUTUSANG TAGAPAGPAGANAP BLG. 209, (ANG FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, BILANG NAAMYENDAHAN) UPANG MAILAGAY ANG FAMILY PLANNING SEMINAR BILANG KAHINGIAN PARA SA PAG-IISYU NG LISENSIYA SA KASAL AT SA IBA PANG MGA LAYUNIN (AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 11 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 209, (THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED) SO AS TO INCLUDE FAMILY PLANNING SEMINAR AS A REQUISITE FOR THE ISSUANCE OF A MARRIAGE LICENSE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES)
rows.abstract: Nagsasaad na WALANG APLIKASYON SA PAGKUHA NG LISENSIYA SA KASAL ANG AAPRUBAHAN AT WALANG LISENSIYA SA KASAL ANG IGAGAWAD HANGGANG HINDI NAGSUSUMITE ANG MGA NAGKAKASUNDONG PANIG NG SERTIPIKO NG PADALO SA ISANG FAMILY PLANNINGG SEMINAR.   (Provides that NO APPLICATION FOR MARRIAGE LICENSE SHALL BE APPROVED AND NO MARRIAGE LICENSE SHALL BE ISSUED UNLESS THE CONTRACTING PARTIES SUBMIT A CERTIFICATION OF ATTENDANCE IN A FAMILY PLANNING SEMINAR.)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2008-08-05

rows.title_full: AN ACT CONVERTING THE ILOILO STATE COLLEGE OF FISHERIES INTO A STATE UNIVERSITY TO BE KNOWN AS THE ILOILO STATE UNIVERSITY OF FISHERIES, SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY AND APPROPRIATING ADDITIONAL FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Substituted by HB07121

rows.author: F097
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING ON TRANSMISSION COMPANIES THE OBLIGATION TO PROVIDE BENEFITS TO HOST COMMUNITIES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9136, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"ELECTRIC POWER INDUSTRY REFORM ACT OF 2001\"

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 2008-08-05

rows.status: Substituted by HB06469
